entities.summary: Ivan Vasilyevich Dvorny was a Russian basketball player who won the gold medal with the Soviet national basketball team at the 1972 Summer Olympics. He played for Uralmash in Sverdlovsk, as well as for BC Spartak in Leningrad, BC Spartak Primorye in Vladivostok and Dynamo Moscow.
